owner_intent: Maximize personal offline Shire Journey production speed without allowing private-use art/audio to contaminate the separately distributable/commercial framework.

required_metadata: source/provider or user-supplied origin when known
restrictions: Never classify as distributable/commercial Approved merely because local import works.
Never include in the sellable Framework package, release asset bundle, public repository, marketplace package or reusable commercial sample content.
Unknown/franchise/ripped/editorial assets remain replaceable temporary/private media, not project-owned final art.
Do not remove source/provenance notes merely to silence CI.
Provider-access rules remain binding: no authentication, paywall, DRM or anti-bot bypass.

DISTRIBUTABLE_FRAMEWORK.purpose: Reusable framework and any future product/release intended for third parties.
requirements: no unknown-license, ripped, editorial-only or private-offline-only art/audio
commercial package must build without depending on Private Offline assets

isolation_contract.git_policy: Keep PRIVATE_OFFLINE_ONLY payloads out of distributable/public package history unless their redistribution rights are separately cleared.
isolation_contract.framework_dependency_rule: Framework code and data contracts must not hard-reference Private Offline payloads; private integration should remain swappable/soft-referenced where runtime integration is needed.
isolation_contract.export_gate: Any framework/release export must run a zero-PRIVATE_OFFLINE dependency check before distribution.

workflow_rule: License uncertainty must not stop personal offline experimentation, but it changes classification and export eligibility. Access restrictions and technical safety/intake checks still apply.
truth_boundary: PRIVATE_OFFLINE_IMPORTED means only that the user's private local project can consume the asset. It does not prove ownership, redistribution rights, commercial clearance, UE acceptance, visual acceptance or device performance.
